opening.argument: The presentation makes the supposed mining success story unmistakably absurd. The speaker says, “i have fruits all over my body,” while appearing on camera in an exaggerated costume covered in colorful fruit. The call to action is equally comic: “Just stop what you're doing right now and start mining wang coins.” Together with the inconsistent references to “wang coins” and “wet coins,” these details frame the wealth claims as parody rather than a concrete solicitation to participate in a real mining or investment offer. The fruit-covered costume, exaggerated physical consequence, and implausible coin names signal general entertainment and comic commentary, without establishing a real process for participation or investment.
